markets.rules_primary: If SF 49ers D/ST scores the first touchdown in San Francisco vs Atlanta Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to SF 49ers D/ST in the San Francisco vs Atlanta professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026. If SF 49ers D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once SF 49ers D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
